title.narrative: JESSY OJOMA DRIVE FOR ENVIRONMENTAL FOUNDATION VULNERABLE PERSONS' NUTRITION

description.narrative: This project intends to provide general food distribution to 200 vulnerable households (both displaced and host families) and also provide multi-user gender-sensitive pit toilet facilities for the use of the displaced and host families to avoid open defecation. The project would also provide basic treatment for malaria which is now also common. Finally, to avoid further cases of malnutrition project will provide Vitamin A fortified cassava cuttings, seeds for vegetable gardening, and fertilizers to the affected families to start faming within the host community to ameliorate the suffering of the displaced and t families hosting them.
